text: 826 Masonic is a charming, sun-filled 4 bed 2 bathroom house right on the edge of the Panhandle.
We have two rooms, both available starting Dec 1st (or even earlier) We ideally want someone to join us full time but are open to sublets.

The neighborhood is exceptionally safe, with bus stops nearby that take you all over SF, and grocery stores and great restaurants walking distance away. We don’t have a garage, but there’s street parking everywhere (Kevin owns a car and just parks it in the vicinity) We do have a patio, backyard, and in-unit laundry.
Shared bathroom (with Diana across the hall)
Privacy + UV shields on all windows, large closet
Second floor (same as living room and kitchen)
Diana is a native Berliner fresh out of Stanford, working as an open source software engineer at Uber. She’s cheerful, chatty, and full of surprises, and will always lend you her makeup in a pinch.

My first interaction with Kevin was him asking our group chat if there was somewhere he could put his 3-D printer. I didn’t know Kevin at all before living with him, but in mere weeks he became one of my favorite people, ever. Incredibly kind, stoic, and the best at witty banter or dissecting the world through the lens of media theory. He’s a computer vision researcher at a space satellite startup. He also (!) used to do standup comedy. He drinks a comical amount of milk.
